body:
## Context
Issue #611: In `packages/context-handoff/lib/bypass-grant.mjs` (and its Claude Code / Codex hook twins), `constants.O_NOFOLLOW` and `constants.O_NONBLOCK` are undefined on Windows, coercing `constants.O_RDONLY | undefined` to plain `O_RDONLY` without any guard or lstat check, and `recovery-exception.mjs` (and its hook twins) requires candidate paths to start with `/`, rejecting Windows drive-letter absolute paths (`C:\...`).
Issue #609: Disclose in `packages/context-handoff/README.md` next to the `bypass` description that a hard-degraded session whose shell environment inherits `ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY` can clear its own D1/D2 via the allowlisted `bypass --write` command, and note Phase 1 host-owned integrity anchor / operator-TTY follow-up.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `readBypassGrant` in `packages/context-handoff/lib/bypass-grant.mjs` and `readVerifiedBypassGrant` in the Claude Code / Codex hook twins verify that `O_NOFOLLOW` and `O_NONBLOCK` are finite numbers (falling back to fail-closed `null` when unavailable so symlink/FIFO protection never silently evaporates).
- `recovery-exception.mjs` and its Claude Code / Codex hook twins accept both POSIX (`/`) and Windows drive-letter (`C:\` / `C:/`) absolute paths in `matchRecoveryCommand` and `identityMatches`.
- `packages/context-handoff/README.md` discloses the inherited-`ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY` self-bypass residual next to the `bypass` description.

## Verification
`node --test packages/context-handoff/test/windows-and-residuals.test.mjs packages/context-handoff/adapter-test/cc-helper-drift.test.mjs packages/context-handoff/adapter-test/codex-helper-drift.test.mjs`
title: context-handoff: guard Windows O_NOFOLLOW/drive-letter recovery and disclose inherited-key bypass residual (#611, #609)
